title: Spokane Creek Cabins & Campground

services.name: RV sites
services.desc: Spokane Creek offers 24 camp sites ideal for tents, pop-up, truck campers or small RVs. Our camp sites are positioned along the creek and have a picnic table and fire ring. and 14 are water and electric only - a dump station is located by the shower house and is free for our guests. Most of our sites are 60 feet long and 30 feet wide. However, we do have 9 sites that are shorter in length - from 25 feet to 40 feet. Because of the size differences it is important to let us know what size your rig is so that we can ensure that you are in a spot that fits your needs. Our RV sites are level, grassy spots and have a picnic table at each location. Due to the proximity to the US Forest Service

blurb: Spokane Creek offers a unique lodging and family vacation experience close to Mt Rushmore and Custer State Park in the heart of the Black Hills. Whether you are looking for a vacation cabin, an RV site, or a place to pitch a tent, we offer a wide variety of vacation options to meet everyone’s budget and needs.
